deliberateDelta.classification: renderer non-determinism, not attributable to the CSS change
evidence: A control capture (after-repeat) photographed the SAME post-change CSS a second time, with identical viewport, locale, timezone, Chrome build and run data.
after vs after-repeat reproduces the SAME 11 pixel coordinates with the same bounds, so the delta appears with no CSS change at all.

before-local/dark/integrations.png and after-repeat/dark/integrations.png are BYTE-IDENTICAL (sha256 78de89d8f05f4ee996b066b04489edaae903351ed52c70f92775bdee2132ada8) despite being built from different CSS. The route renders in one of two states; which state a run lands in is independent of the stylesheet.
Every difference is +/-1 to +/-3 on a single channel at an antialiased gradient edge; no token value, geometry or layout moved.
deliberateDelta.handling: Identified and reported, never masked and never restaged. The pixels are left in the capture exactly as the browser produced them.
